content: Meditation is a practice of focusing attention inward to develop mindfulness and peace. Beginning practitioners often find it helpful to start with just five minutes daily in a quiet space. Techniques include focusing on breath, body scans, or mantra repetition. Regular practice has been shown to reduce stress, improve emotional regulation, and enhance overall wellbeing.
